name: Admin and viewer in the web UI: admin, then viewer (no download permission), then admin again, signing out and in from the drawer without a reload. Admin: the drawer's admin section, GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics 200, a range bookmark's Make a clip button and the editor's Save & make clip. Viewer: no admin section and no admin link of ours in the drawer, Admin/Diagnostics 403, only the viewer's own bookmark in the details section, no Make a clip button, no Save & make clip, and making a clip through the API is refused (403). Back as admin: admin's bookmarks and clip controls again. Creates one range bookmark per user on Long Test Movie and deletes both at the end (sandbox data only).

steps.name: mark this page load (no reload may happen from here on)
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: admin's range bookmark 0:50-0:55 ('webcheck-users admin')
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (b.Note === 'webcheck-users admin') { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } } const r = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 500000000, EndTicks: 550000000, Note: 'webcheck-users admin' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return r.Id;

steps.name: admin: Capabilities and GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics
steps.eval: (async () => { const caps = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Capabilities')); const d = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics'), { headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } }); return { IsAdmin: caps.IsAdmin, CanCreateClips: caps.CanCreateClips, diagnostics: d.status }; })()

steps.name: admin: an admin with clips, Diagnostics 200
drawer open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .userMenuOptions'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.left >= 0; })()

steps.name: admin: jellyfin-web's admin section is there
admin: the section lists admin's range with its Make a clip button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const row = [...s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users admin')); return !!row && !!row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Make a clip"]') && { rows: s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row').length }; })()

steps.name: admin: open the range's editor
steps.script: const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users admin')); row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Edit"]').click(); return true;

steps.name: admin: the editor offers Save & make clip and the clip mode
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Edit bookmark') return false; const labels = [...p.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()); return labels.includes('Save & make clip') && !!p.querySelector('select[aria-label="Clip mode"]') && labels; })()

steps.name: open the drawer to sign out
Sign out visible in the drawer
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .btnLogout'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

steps.name: sign in as viewer, in the same page load
viewer signed in, without a reload
viewer's own range bookmark 0:52-0:56 ('webcheck-users viewer')
steps.script: const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (b.Note === 'webcheck-users viewer') { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id) }); } } const r = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 520000000, EndTicks: 560000000, Note: 'webcheck-users viewer' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return r.Id;

steps.name: viewer: Capabilities, Diagnostics, a clip through the API, admin's bookmark
steps.eval: (async () => { const auth = { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' }; const caps = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Capabilities')); const d = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics'), { headers: auth }); const clip = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.viewerBookmark + '/Clip'), { method: 'POST', headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, auth), body: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }) }); const other = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.adminBookmark), { headers: auth }); return { IsAdmin: caps.IsAdmin, CanCreateClips: caps.CanCreateClips, diagnostics: d.status, clip: clip.status, clipType: clip.headers.get('content-type'), adminBookmark: other.status }; })()

steps.name: viewer: not an admin, no clips; Diagnostics 403, a clip 403 (ProblemDetails), admin's bookmark 404
drawer open
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .userMenuOptions'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && r.left >= 0; })()

steps.name: viewer's drawer
steps.eval: ({ adminSection: !!document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .adminMenuOptions'), dashboardLinks: document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer a[href*="dashboard"], .mainDrawer a[href*="configurationpage"]').length, ourLinks: [...document.querySelectorAll('.mainDrawer [data-jfkit-plugin]')].map(a => a.getAttribute('href')) })

steps.name: viewer: no admin section, no dashboard link, no admin link of ours
viewer: the section lists the viewer's bookmark and none of admin's, with no Make a clip button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const rows = [...s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')]; const own = rows.find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users viewer')); return !!own && !rows.some(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users admin') || r.textContent.includes('webcheck-ui range')) && !s.querySelector('button[title="Make a clip"], button[title="Make the clip again"]') && { title: s.querySelector('h2').textContent, rows: rows.length, buttons: [...own.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-actions button')].map(b => b.getAttribute('title')) }; })()

steps.name: viewer: the Add bookmark button is still there
viewer: open the range's editor
steps.script: const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users viewer')); row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Edit"]').click(); return true;

steps.name: viewer: the editor has Save but no Save & make clip and no clip mode
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Edit bookmark') return false; const labels = [...p.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => b.textContent.trim()); return labels.includes('Save') && !labels.includes('Save & make clip') && !p.querySelector('select[aria-label="Clip mode"]') && labels; })()

steps.name: viewer: delete the viewer's bookmark
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.viewerBookmark) }); return true;

steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const rows = [...s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')]; const row = rows.find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users admin')); return !!row && !rows.some(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-users viewer')) && !!row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Make a clip"]') && { rows: rows.length }; })()
